name: The Sleeping Griffon

rooms.name: The Rookie Loft
rooms.perk: +10% XP for your first 7 days in Aetheria; the walls are carved with the names of every Veilborn who slept here first

dish.name: Marta's Rookie Stew
dish.effect: +HP regen; the first bowl is always free

quirk: Feeds every rookie on credit and remembers every debt
events: Sir Aldric asleep on a table
secret: Among the carved names in the Rookie Loft are all three previous Heroes. Kaede's is carved twice. And the cat has lived here for 400 years.

name: The Crooked Lantern

rooms.name: The Room That Moves
rooms.perk: Each night it opens onto a different hallway; one night it opens onto a hidden lore room

quirk: The building leans more every year; nobody admits it
events: A guest is a cursed frog prince
secret: Mother Bramble is the one who cursed half of her guests, by accident, decades ago.

name: Leafhall Rest

rooms.name: Heartwood Bower
rooms.perk: Sleep inside a living tree: +Spirit regen and a Sylvara Devotion point once a week

quirk: Charges humans double until they earn elven reputation (the court-elf snobbery, Canon)
events: A noble asks you to carry a secret letter
secret: Thalion is a disgraced court mage hiding in plain sight.

name: The Thimble & Thistle

rooms.name: The Acorn Room
rooms.perk: Only reachable while shrunk; one crumb of bread feeds the whole party

dish.name: One Blueberry (whole)
dish.effect: A full meal for the tiny; +stamina

quirk: You must drink a shrinking draught at the door
rumorTheme: Beetle riders, giant cats, the "big folk"
events: A spider at the window is a dragon to them
secret: The inn is built inside the lost boot of a previous Hero.

name: The Anvil's Rest

rooms.name: The Forge Room
rooms.perk: Heated by the forge below: +1 crafting quality on your next Blacksmithing job

quirk: Drinking contests every night; the record holder is 300 years old
events: A rune-smith wants a rare ore
secret: A sealed door in the cellar leads to an Underworld Deepgate.

name: The Howling Hearth

rooms.name: The Pack Den
rooms.perk: Sleep in the shared fur-pile: +Bond with every companion present

quirk: No chairs; everyone eats on the floor and arm-wrestles for the last piece
secret: Grandma Ruka was an S-rank adventurer who retired after the Siege of Marrowgate.

name: Ryokan Moon-on-Water

rooms.name: The Lantern Garden Suite
rooms.perk: Private hot spring: full HP/MP/SP, removes debuffs, a quiet companion scene

quirk: Guests wear the inn's robes; spirits check in after midnight
rumorTheme: Shrines, the Oni Volcano, the spirit world
events: A spirit guest asks for help
secret: One of the staff is a fox spirit from the Kitsune Isles.

name: The Ninth Tail Teahouse

rooms.name: Contract Room
rooms.perk: Paid with a memory or a story, not coins. A binding contract (Canon: spirit contracts are magic)

drink.name: Moonlit Sake (or tea)
drink.effect: Lets you see spirits for the night

quirk: Spirits run it; humans are guests. Breaking house rules breaks a contract
rumorTheme: Spirit contracts, Suzune's family, the veil
events: A tanuki tries to pay with leaves
secret: The memories guests pay with are stored in the teahouse's cellar, and one belongs to you from Earth.

name: The Wandering Dragon Inn

rooms.name: The Quiet Room
rooms.perk: Meditation room: +cultivation progress overnight

quirk: Martial artists fight over tables; the inn charges for broken furniture in advance
events: A beggar who is a grandmaster
A manual hidden in a teapot
secret: Feng is a sealed martial saint guarding a forbidden manual.

name: Cloud Gate Guesthouse

rooms.name: The Warm Floor Room
rooms.perk: Heated stone floors: full climate comfort and +stamina for the next day

quirk: Shoes off at the door; the keeper remembers every guest's favorite side dish
events: A scholar studying for the exams asks you to quiz them
secret: The guesthouse's jars hold a mountain spirit's tears.

name: The Last Fire

rooms.name: Hearthside Bench
rooms.perk: Sleep by the great fire: full cold comfort and a skald's story (lore)

quirk: The fire has never gone out in 600 years; letting it die is a crime
rumorTheme: The Shattered Sky, frost giants, lost ships
events: A frozen traveler at the door
secret: The fire is a bound fire spirit who wants to be free.

name: The Oasis Caravanserai

rooms.name: The Star Roof
rooms.perk: Sleep under the stars: reveals a hidden desert ruin on your map once

quirk: Every trade route in the desert passes through; caravans arrive with news
secret: Its oldest well leads to the ruins of the empire below.

name: The Drowned Mermaid

rooms.name: The Captain's Cabin
rooms.perk: A smuggler's trapdoor: leave town unseen (clears pursuit by bounty hunters)

quirk: Sea shanties every night; card sharks at every table
events: A press-gang tries to recruit you
secret: Delphine runs the smugglers' ring; she'll trade secrets for favors.

name: The Whale's Belly

rooms.name: The Blowhole View
rooms.perk: Wake up somewhere new: the whale moved overnight, revealing a new map area

quirk: The whole inn sways; first-time guests get seasick (a short debuff)
rumorTheme: Where the whale is going, sand pirates
events: The whale sings and everyone stops
secret: The whale is old and dying, and the town doesn't know.

name: The Friendly Goblin
keeperName: Grukk the Younger (if spared twice) or Old Snaggle

rooms.name: The Peace Room
rooms.perk: Humans and monsters share a table: +monster-town reputation

quirk: Monster-run; humans welcome if they're polite. Weapons stay at the door
events: A slime asks you to settle a dispute
secret: If you spared Grukk twice, he runs it, and he named it after his father.

name: The Deep Pint

rooms.name: Bunk 30
rooms.perk: Save point and Labyrinth checkpoint; restocks your belt

quirk: The only bar 30 floors down; prices are 3× and nobody complains
rumorTheme: Deeper floors, lost parties, the Maze King
secret: Dorgrim has never been to the surface.

name: The Lantern Wake

rooms.name: The Quiet Bed
rooms.perk: Paid in candle stubs (itm_mat_candle_stub). You dream of the adventurers who died in the Labyrinth

quirk: All guests are ghosts except you
events: A ghost asks you to deliver a last letter upstairs
secret: The Hostess is waiting for one specific living adventurer.

name: The Imperial Grand Hotel

rooms.name: The Ambassador Suite
rooms.perk: Status symbol: +Renown with Imperium nobles; every wall has ears

quirk: Luxurious, cold and full of spies
rumorTheme: Imperial politics, the war, the real Mina's prison
events: A spy plants a note in your coat
A ball you weren't invited to
secret: The hotel basement connects to the prison where the real Mina is held.

name: The Hour That Isn't

rooms.name: The Forever Room
rooms.perk: Paid with a name, a laugh or a color. One night here can pass as a week outside (the inn warns you, sometimes)

dish.name: Fairy Feast
dish.effect: +all stats; never eat the third course

quirk: Fey hospitality: politeness is law, thanks are debts
rumorTheme: Fey bargains, stolen children, the courts
events: A fey noble wants to buy your shadow
secret: The inn is a fey lord's pocket world, and he wants to keep a guest forever.

name: The Crimson Rest

rooms.name: The Neutral Room
rooms.perk: Sanctuary: no fighting allowed, even for the Overlord's soldiers

quirk: Demon civilians live ordinary lives here (Canon: consequences on every side)
rumorTheme: The war from the other side, the Generals
events: A demon family hides a deserter
secret: Madam Vessa lost a son to a human adventurer. She knows it was you, or someone like you.
